issues.subject: Midterm flip, a $1B interceptor OTA, and who actually buys
lines: DIU's Bridge program helps firms on DIU contracts clear clearance, SCIF and ATO hurdles. A two-star's reminder: PAEs, not DIU, do the buying.
Drone Dominance picked 11 firms for 30,000 small drones with no guaranteed follow-on, and industry is split on whether that builds an industrial base.
The Army's $1B Future Interceptor OTA to Lockheed carries a $423M company cost share.
OSC offered Neros a conditional loan of up to $450M, and the Army is pitching its real estate to private capital.
SCO projects $2.6B in FY27 and up to 17 new projects, run by a staff of fewer than 40 civilians.
AFRL wants hypersonic engine white papers by Nov. 16, and the Space Force wants cislunar kit ready by 2029.
Perplexity is the first full FedRAMP 20x Class C certification under the 2026 rules.
Democrats take both chambers in January, and NDAA right-to-repair fights continue.

issues.subject: Army automates ATOs and opens drone ranges; GSA reprices AI
lines: Army's Project Gatekeeper goes live to cut software ATOs to near-real-time pipeline checks.
Army adds two Indiana sites to its list of permissive ranges for commercial drone and counter-drone testing.
SOCOM gives Smack Technologies an OT worth up to $7.5M to prototype AI campaign planning.
Office of Strategic Capital offers Stoke Space a $150M conditional loan for a Cape Canaveral launch pad.
GSA's new Anthropic OneGov deal moves Claude to consumption pricing at a 40% discount.
Pentagon says it obligated 97.5% of FY2026 reconciliation money; Iran war costs top $47B.
DHS takes its procurement forecast system offline Oct. 30 during a migration.
Air Force puts ARRW into production with a $694M Lockheed award and taps startup Castelion for F-16 hypersonics.

issues.subject: AUTOWARCOM roadmap, OT-first guidance, and a $100M armed-USV sprint
lines: Project Agincourt lays out a roadmap to stand up a four-star Autonomous Warfare Command by Oct. 1, 2027.
DoW's new prototype OT guide says OTs are now explicitly preferred, with problem statements replacing statements of work.
DIU and DRPM UxS open a 120-day armed-USV counter-UAS sprint inside a prize challenge worth up to $100M.
The Air Force folds 50-plus battle network programs into a single $4.5B Megatron vehicle.
Army's Project Gatekeeper lets companies vet software for Army networks without a contract or sponsor.
Space Systems Command's Kronos commercial solutions opportunity opens in January 2027.
Pentagon and Lockheed agree on a 10-year F-35 framework that depends on multiyear authority in the FY27 NDAA and on funding.
